title: Elytra
safeHtml:
The '''Elytra''' is a means of Transport in Los Sengas. Users can wear Elytras to fly in the sky at extremely high speeds. However, it is recommended that players equip at least 64 rockets, otherwise risks of players falling into the sea before reaching his/her intended destination may arise. It is also recommended for players to equip at least 2 Elytras that are enchanted with Unbreaking III, otherwise Elytras may become damaged, and players may also fall to their deaths if it took place over land.

Flying Speeds

When using Rockets as propulsion, the speeds of Elytra can reach up to 130 km/h. Elytras enchanted with Unbreaking III have a durability of 27 minutes and has a range of approximately 58.5 km.

  • Flight Times taken:
  • Metropolis to Info Island: 2 Minutes
  • Southeast Island to Info Island: 5 Minutes

Effects

  • The number of passengers using Nazca Railway and other means of land transport will reduce.
  • May cause the Server TPS to decrease.
  • Rockets that feature Firework Stars may cause bodily harm and even death to nearby players or the player him/herself.
